chunks: From him, from al-Hajjal, from Tha'labah, from Ma'mar ibn 'Umar, who said:
I asked Aba Ja'far عليه السلام about the sick person: does he make up the salat (prayer) if he had been rendered unconscious? He said: No.

key_terms.أُغْمِيَ: was rendered unconscious or lost awareness
key_terms.الْمَرِيضِ: the sick person being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.لَا: a negation indicating that no make-up is required
key_terms.يَقْضِي: to make up an act of worship after its time has passed

ai.seo_question: Does an unconscious sick person have to make up missed salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a sick person who was overcome by unconsciousness. Imam Aba Ja'far عليه السلام states that such a person does not make up the missed salat (prayer) for that period.
